meta.scalability_note: 12 global locations including Frankfurt, Amsterdam, Warsaw, Helsinki, London; managed K8s with node auto-scaling; no serverless FaaS
meta.performance_note: 99.999% uptime SLA (industry-leading); ISO 27001; MaxIOPS NVMe storage; 25 Gbps network; low-latency EU backbone

AWS Amplify.note: No full-stack application hosting or CI/CD platform equivalent to Amplify

AWS Lambda.note: No FaaS or serverless function service available

Amazon ECS.note: No managed container runtime service; containers are deployed via Kubernetes only

Amazon EKS.note: Fully managed Kubernetes, node group auto-scaling, integrated with UpCloud networking and storage

Amazon EC2.note: Flexible VM instances with NVMe SSD, hourly/monthly billing, available across multiple EU locations

AWS Batch.note: No managed batch compute service available

AWS Elastic Beanstalk.note: No PaaS application deployment platform available

Amazon S3.note: Multi-region EU deployment, full S3 API compatibility, versioning, and lifecycle policies

Amazon EBS.note: NVMe-based block volumes up to 1M IOPS, snapshots, and cross-AZ attach supported

AWS Backup.note: Automated backup policies for servers and storage; point-in-time restore; cross-location replication

Amazon EFS.note: No managed shared/elastic file system service available

Amazon RDS.note: Fully managed relational database with automated backups, failover, and read replicas

Amazon DocumentDB.note: No managed MongoDB-compatible or document database service available

Amazon DynamoDB.note: No managed serverless NoSQL key-value/document database available

Amazon Timestream.note: No managed time-series database service available

Amazon Aurora.note: No MySQL/PostgreSQL-compatible high-performance managed cloud database equivalent

Amazon ElastiCache.note: Fully managed Redis cluster with HA and automatic failover; included in the Managed Database product

Amazon Redshift.note: No managed cloud data warehouse service available

AWS Application Load Balancer.note: Managed HTTP/HTTPS load balancer with TLS termination, health checks, and advanced routing rules

AWS Network Load Balancer.note: TCP mode available within the same Load Balancer product; limited UDP support compared to AWS NLB

Amazon VPC.note: Private networks, IP routing, security groups, and floating IPs for full network isolation

Amazon Route 53.note: Managed DNS with full record type support and low TTL configuration

Amazon API Gateway.note: No managed API gateway or gateway-as-a-service available

AWS Direct Connect.note: No dedicated private connectivity product equivalent to Direct Connect

Amazon Rekognition.note: No managed image or video analysis AI service available

Amazon SageMaker.note: No managed ML model training and deployment platform available

Amazon Bedrock.note: No managed foundation model or generative AI API service available

AWS Glue.note: No managed ETL or data integration service available

Amazon EMR.note: No managed big data processing (Spark/Hadoop) service available

Amazon Athena.note: No serverless interactive query service for object storage available

AWS IAM.note: Full RBAC with users, roles, policies, and IP-restricted API tokens

Amazon Cognito.note: No managed identity and user pool service for application authentication

AWS IAM Identity Center.note: No SSO or centralised identity federation service available

AWS KMS.note: No managed key management service; encryption at rest is provided at the infrastructure level

AWS Secrets Manager.note: No managed secrets storage or rotation service available

AWS Certificate Manager.note: TLS certificate provisioning via Load Balancer with Let's Encrypt auto-renewal; no standalone certificate management service

Amazon GuardDuty.note: No managed threat detection or intelligent security monitoring service available

AWS Security Hub.note: No centralised security posture management or aggregation service available

AWS Config.note: No managed resource configuration tracking or compliance service available

AWS Shield.note: Network-level DDoS mitigation included in all plans; no advanced application-layer protection service

AWS WAF.note: No managed web application firewall service available

AWS CloudTrail.note: Account activity and API audit logging available; limited export options and retention compared to CloudTrail

Amazon CloudWatch.note: Built-in metrics and alerting for servers, load balancers, and databases; less integrated and feature-rich than CloudWatch

Amazon SNS.note: No managed pub/sub notification or messaging service available

AWS Systems Manager.note: No managed operational management or configuration compliance service available

AWS Cost Explorer.note: Detailed cost breakdown per resource and zone available in the management console

AWS CodeBuild.note: No managed CI build service available

AWS CodeDeploy.note: No managed deployment automation service available

AWS CodePipeline.note: No managed CI/CD pipeline orchestration service available

Amazon ECR.note: No managed container registry; customers use Docker Hub or self-hosted registries

AWS CloudFormation.note: No native IaC service; official Terraform provider available for infrastructure automation

AWS IoT Core.note: No managed IoT connectivity or device messaging service available

AWS IoT Device Management.note: No managed IoT device fleet management service available

Amazon SQS.note: No managed message queue service available

Amazon EventBridge.note: No managed serverless event bus or event routing service available

AWS Step Functions.note: No managed workflow orchestration or state machine service available

Amazon SES.note: No managed transactional email sending service available

Amazon Kinesis.note: No managed real-time data streaming service available
